method: Actual corrected GLB, source photograph orthographic camera, 32px tile ray acceleration. A candidate is retained only when its centroid ray first hits the exact same source mesh and triangle.
limitations: This tests first visibility at each candidate triangle centroid, not an exact full-triangle occlusion clip.
ROI membership and visibility do not certify the source AI triangle as an actual manufactured PU layer.
Unobserved connector backs and factory joining structure are not reconstructed.
